# Fulcrum (oasis-fulcrum)

> Fulcrum is the economics, FinOps and sustainability companion to the OASIS methodology — implementing Chapter 22: unit economics, cost/value density, token-cost tracking, and the six-phase lifecycle for architecting, instrumenting and optimizing AI economics.

See [INDEX.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/INDEX.md) for the complete flat file list.

## Foundations and cost economics

- [What Is AI FinOps](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/01-foundations/what-is-ai-finops.md)
- [The Two Ledgers: Cost and Value](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/01-foundations/two-ledgers-cost-and-value.md)
- [Total Economic Cost](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/02-cost-economics/total-economic-cost.md)
- [The Three Hidden Cost Multipliers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/02-cost-economics/hidden-multipliers.md)

## Value, measurement and architecture

- [Value Calculation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/03-value-economics/value-calculation.md)
- [Cost Density and Value Density](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/04-measurement-and-observability/cost-value-density.md)
- [Metrics Catalog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/04-measurement-and-observability/metrics-catalog.md): every metric with formula, frequency and owner — including why token cost is tracked continuously.
- [Six Optimization Levers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/knowledgetrailsai/OASIS-AI-FINOPS/main/05-architecture-and-design/optimization-levers.md)
